gap: No result ChatGPT got states cost per measured usable Wh at today's US store prices. On that basis the BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 2×200 W kit costs $0.78 per usable Wh ($1,499 / 1,910 Wh measured by StorageReview), and the AC180 + 2×200 W kit costs $1.20 per usable Wh ($1,232 / 1,030 Wh measured by StorageReview), even though both come with the same 400 W of panels.
standout_why: I compared against balconysolarkits.us/kits (cited), solutionenergy.com/solar/balcony/with-battery (cited) and our own dealectric.com/balcony-solar-system-with-battery-us. wattbalcon.fr would not load (certificate error) and us.zendure.com returned HTTP 429, so I could not check those two. balconysolarkits.us gives no battery Wh or panel W for any US kit, and it marks EcoFlow STREAM as Utah-only with the US store page removed. SolutionEnergy works out runtime from an assumed usable capacity (capacity × 0.85) and an 0.8 panel derate. Its only cost-per-kWh figure is for the sold-out Zendure, and it gives no US price for the AC180 or C1000 Gen 2 kits. Our own page has refill hours and cost per rated Wh, but at $1,232 for the AC180 kit it does not use any measured usable capacity. None of these pages divides today's price by reviewer-measured delivered Wh, and none notes that the AC180 + 200 W kit costs $463 less than the 2×200 W version.
decides: This backs the BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 2×200 W ($0.78 per usable Wh, 5.2 h refill in full sun) over the AC180 + 2×200 W ($1.20 per usable Wh). The AC180 only makes sense as the cheap one-panel kit at $769 ($0.75 per usable Wh, but 5.8 h refill). ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 + SP037 is still cheapest per rated Wh ($948 / 1,920 = $0.49), but no reviewer has measured its usable capacity, so it can't be ranked on usable Wh. Both units with measured capacity deliver 83–92% of their rating (StorageReview), so applying a blanket 85% factor to unmeasured units is a reasonable estimate, not a measurement. None of these grid-feeding plug-in kits with a battery can be bought now in the US: STREAM is Utah-only and its store page was removed, and SolarFlow is sold out. So these power-station-plus-panel kits are the battery kits a US shopper can actually buy.
